entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: Great conflict of Dominaria's Mythohistory among the Elder Dragons, after which only seven survived.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: Powerful dragons who fought in the war.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who manipulated the dragon clans and came to rule half of Dominaria.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder dragon whose descendants raided Bolas's lands.

entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: Sibling of Vaevictis killed by a poisoned arrow.

entities.name: Ravus
entities.description: Sibling of Vaevictis killed by Bolas's sorcerers.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Dragon easily influenced to join the fray.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Clever dragon who hid himself while pretending to be something he was not.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: Wise dragon who joined the war while hearing Bolas's whispers; nearly defeated by Bolas.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker whose intervention saved Sabboth and ended the war.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the war was fought.

entities.name: Dragon-killers' War
entities.description: Earlier war preceding the Elder Dragon War.

events.summary: Descendants of Vaevictis raid Bolas's lands, are defeated, then Vaevictis and his siblings defeat Bolas's army, which retreats.
events.quote: Bolas' army suffered a shattering defeat and had to retreat into the mountains

events.summary: Bolas's sorcerers kill Ravus and Bolas overpowers Lividus's mind and turns him against Vaevictis, allowing escape.
events.quote: the sorcerers of Bolas' army managed to kill Ravus

events.summary: Bolas manipulates the dragon clans against each other.
events.quote: Manipulating the many dragon clans, he turned them against each other.

events.summary: The war spreads across the seas, and Arcades Sabboth joins, listening to Bolas's whispers.
events.quote: Even the wise Arcades Sabboth threw his might into the great war

events.summary: In the last clash on Jamuraa, Ugin's intervention saves Sabboth; Bolas's spark ignites in rage and envy and he planeswalks away, ending the war.
events.quote: Only the unexpected intervention of Ugin prevented the ultimate defeat of Sabboth.
